news.title: In Doonbeg, Trump’s Irish Open Visit Prompts Protests and Praise
news.summary: As the U.S. president heads to his Doonbeg hotel for the Irish Open, locals expressed both appreciation for the resort’s economic benefits and opposition to his politics.
